label: Silent twin — self-employment under $50,000 with a compensation figure
scenario: Schedule SE net earnings are $49,999, under the $50,000 band. An explicit compensation figure of $20,000 leaves a gap above $25,000. Type 2b stays silent. The gap does not open below the band. At $100,000 or more, self-employment income is High on its own. The retirement deduction is already present.
